high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a webpage from Mongabay India, featuring an article about research findings related to predatory behavior and diet in the Dehing Patkai rainforest. The webpage is accessed via a mobile browser, as indicated by the status bar at the top showing the time (8:14) and battery level. The text mentions Bilal Habib, the principal investigator of the paper, who told Mongabay India that the findings made through camera trapping contribute to understanding predatory behavior and diet, emphasizing the significance of conservation efforts for both species.
